title: Shift-Left Investment Judge
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: AI economics
description: The learner will judge, for each of six AI investment options, whether to fund it using the rule that savings from moving defects to an earlier phase must be at least twice the cost.

learningObjectives: The learner will judge, for each of six AI investment options, whether to fund it using the rule that savings from moving defects to an earlier phase must be at least twice the cost.
prerequisites: the defect fix costs by phase

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit-then-explore: predict, receive feedback, then explore
commonMisconceptions: (1) The option that moves the most defects is the best. (2) Any positive saving justifies funding. (3) The phase the defect moves to does not matter.
assessmentOpportunities: For each of six options the learner commits "Fund" or "Do not fund" before the ratio is shown. A verdict is correct when it matches the Content table. Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. Exploration is not evidence.
